title: Descent of a vector-bundle model comparison from normalized charts
statement:
Fix the finite purity datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi_F$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$. Let $Z$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $\pi:V\to Z$ be a vector bundle of constant rank $d\geq0$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Work in the small pro-etale derived categories with the derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], constructible exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and coefficient twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Put $Q=A_V(d)[2d]$ and $\omega_\pi=R\pi^!A_Z$.
Let $c:Q\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_\pi$ be a specified isomorphism. Suppose a set-indexed Zariski open cover $\{u_i:U_i\hookrightarrow Z\}_{i\in I}$ and linear trivializations $\phi_i:V_i=V\times_ZU_i\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf A^d_{U_i}$ are given. Require that, under the canonical exceptional base-change and coordinate comparisons and the canonical Tate pullback identifications,
$$c|_{V_i}=\Gamma_{p_{d,i},A_{U_i}}\quad\text{for every }i,$$
where $p_{d,i}:\mathbf A^d_{U_i}\to U_i$ [def-sbc-affine-space] and $\Gamma$ is the ordered restricted-projective-line-trace comparison at every coefficient level explicitly specified in [lem-pur-projection-purity-agreement], with the associators of [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. Then the specified diagonal smooth purity map [def-pur-smooth-purity-map] on the coefficient-unit object satisfies
$$\gamma_{\pi,A_Z}=c:Q\longrightarrow\omega_\pi.$$
The assertion includes rank zero, disconnected or empty $Z$, and every positive coefficient level; no field hypothesis on $A$ is imposed.

source.place: Agreement on the model, final equality of the diagonal and integration orientations; local-to-global form of retained item Step 6, using the chart-normalized comparison as hypothesis.

proof.text: Write $\Pi_\pi:\omega_\pi\xrightarrow{\sim}Q$ for the specified diagonal orientation used in the definition of $\gamma$. The tensor-unit clause of [lem-pur-dualizing-unit-composite] says that $\theta_{\pi,A_Z}:L\pi^*A_Z\otimes^L\omega_\pi\to\omega_\pi$ is the canonical unitor. Substituting $K=A_Z$ into [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], the coefficient-unit pullback and twist reassociation therefore cancel the unitors and give $\gamma_{\pi,A_Z}=\Pi_\pi^{-1}$. This is an equality for the specified tensor transpose, not a choice of a new orientation. Put $a=\Pi_\pi\circ c:Q\to Q$. It suffices to prove $a=1_Q$, because composition with $\Pi_\pi^{-1}$ then gives $c=\gamma_{\pi,A_Z}$.

source.place: Steps 3–4: restriction of the diagonal orientation and agreement with the coordinate-adjunction orientation; local-to-global consequence for normalized bundle charts.

proof.text: Refine the given cover by affine opens $B\subseteq U_i$ that are finite type over $k$. Such opens cover: on a finite-type affine chart $\operatorname{Spec}R$ of $Z$, principal opens contained in $U_i$ form a basis, and $R_f=R[t]/(ft-1)$ is still finitely generated over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $T=V\times_ZB$. The restricted trivialization identifies $T$ with $\mathbf A^d_B=\operatorname{Spec}(R[x_1,\ldots,x_d])$, so $T$ is affine and finite type. These $T$ form a set-indexed open cover of $V$, by taking inverse images of the covering $B$. Vector-bundle projection is affine by its relative-spectrum construction [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], hence separated by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence]; its local polynomial descriptions make it finite type. It is smooth of pure relative dimension $d$ by [sbc-lem-affine-space-smooth] on these charts and the affine-local definition [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Since $Z$ is separated over $k$, $V$ is separated over $k$ by composition [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence]. Thus the finite-type, smooth and separated hypotheses of the chart-normalization theorem hold for $\pi$ and for each restriction.

source.place: Steps 3–4: restriction of the diagonal orientation and agreement with the coordinate-adjunction orientation; local-to-global consequence for normalized bundle charts.

proof.text: Fix a member $B\subseteq U_i$ of the refined cover, put $T=\pi^{-1}B\subseteq V_i$, let $u=\phi_i|_T:T\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf A^d_B$, and let $w:\mathbf A^d_B\hookrightarrow\mathbf A^d_{U_i}$ be the open inclusion. (a) The diagonal orientation on the chart. Apply [lem-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-normalization] with $f=\pi$, affine target open $B$, affine source open $T$ and coordinate morphism the isomorphism (hence etale) $u$: under the specified open exceptional comparison, $\Pi_\pi|_T=Lu^*(\Gamma_{p_d,A_B}^{-1})\circ\epsilon_u$; the theorem explicitly includes all finite extensions and every $n\geq1$. (b) Restriction of $\Gamma$ from $U_i$ to $B$. Here $U_i$ need not be affine, so the chart theorem does not apply over $U_i$ itself. $U_i$ is an open subscheme of the Noetherian scheme $Z$, hence Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian], so $U_i\hookrightarrow Z$ is a quasi-compact open immersion and of finite type [lem-weil-pbc-qc-open-immersion-finite-type]; $U_i$ is separated of finite type over $k$ by composition [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence](e). By [lem-pur-projection-purity-agreement] with $Y=U_i$ and $K=A_{U_i}$, the smooth purity map of $p_{d,i}$ equals $\Gamma_{p_{d,i},A_{U_i}}$. The computation of Step 1, with $p_{d,i}$ in place of $\pi$ (unit clause of [lem-pur-dualizing-unit-composite]), identifies the same smooth purity map with $\vartheta_{p_{d,i}}^{-1}$, so $\Gamma_{p_{d,i},A_{U_i}}=\vartheta_{p_{d,i}}^{-1}$. Now apply [lem-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-normalization] to $f=p_{d,i}$, affine target open $B$, affine source open $\mathbf A^d_B=p_{d,i}^{-1}B$ and coordinate morphism the identity of $\mathbf A^d_B$: it gives $Lw^*\vartheta_{p_{d,i}}=\vartheta_{p_{d,B}}=\Gamma_{p_d,A_B}^{-1}$, where $\epsilon_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the identity identification. Hence, under the open-restriction comparison $Lw^*\omega_{p_{d,i}}\cong\omega_{p_d}$, $Lw^*\Gamma_{p_{d,i},A_{U_i}}=\Gamma_{p_d,A_B}$. (c) Restriction of the hypothesis. The open-restriction, exceptional base-change and coordinate identifications used in the hypothesis and in (a) are composites of the exceptional compositors of [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition] for the commutative square $\pi\circ(T\subseteq V)=(B\subseteq Z)\circ(\pi|_T)$, the equality $\phi_i\circ(T\subseteq V_i)=w\circ u$ and $p_{d,i}\circ w=(B\subseteq U_i)\circ p_d$, with the identification $Rv^!=Lv^*$ for open immersions and isomorphisms $v$. These compositors are conjugates of the compact-support compositors, so the associativity clause of [thm-sf-comp-composition] shows that the two ways of composing them from $Rj_T^!R\pi^!$ to $Lu^*Rp_d^!$ agree. Therefore the restriction to $T$ of the hypothesis $c|_{V_i}=\Gamma_{p_{d,i},A_{U_i}}$ reads $c|_T=\epsilon_u^{-1}\circ Lu^*(Lw^*\Gamma_{p_{d,i},A_{U_i}})$, with the canonical twist identification, and by (b) $c|_T=\epsilon_u^{-1}\circ Lu^*\Gamma_{p_d,A_B}$. (d) Compose (a) and (c): $\epsilon_u$ cancels its inverse and $Lu^*(\Gamma^{-1})Lu^*\Gamma=1$. Consequently $a|_T=\Pi_\pi|_T\circ c|_T=1_{Q|_T}$ for every member of the refined cover. No scalar, frame or orientation is selected in making this cancellation.

proof.text: The finite Tate object $L=A_V(d)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] is an ordinary module sheaf in degree zero, and $Q=L[2d]$. Apply the shift $[-2d]$ to $a$ and the identity and use the canonical inverse-shift identifications, obtaining two endomorphisms $b,1$ of $L[0]$. Exact open restriction commutes with shifts, so the preceding step gives $b|_T=1$ on the same open cover. Both source and target have cohomology only in degree zero. The injectivity clause of [lem-pur-degree-zero-derived-map-gluing], with $M=N=L[0]$, therefore gives $b=1$. Shifting back gives $a=1_Q$: shifts are inverse automorphisms in [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Step 1 now proves the required equality. For $d=0$ the Tate sheaf and shifts are the units, and the chart theorem uses its identity normalization. For empty $Z$ the total space and refined cover are empty and the cited gluing theorem explicitly includes that case. Disconnected bases need no connectedness argument. No use was made of $A$ being a field or of any divisibility condition on $n$.

mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q59-e0c28a832 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: First split of lem-pur-vector-model-chart-descent (0 new nodes). The statement is unchanged and true. It is not on the 2026-10-18/19 dropped list, live still has it unsplit, it cites no SGA, and none of the cited nodes reaches the item (no cycle). I read the master sk-thm-smooth-purity 'Agreement on the model' paragraph (l.26-30, 74-94) and Steps 1-4 of the main-20261015 sk-prop-sp-orientation-charts proof.

Steps 1, 2 and 4 hold.
- Step 1: the unit clause of lem-pur-dualizing-unit-composite makes θ_{π,A} the unitor, so γ_{π,A} = Π^{-1}.
- Step 2: finite-type affine refinement, T ≅ A^d_B, π affine hence separated, smooth chartwise, and (e) composition. These are the hypotheses of the chart theorem.
- Step 4: after unshifting, both objects are degree-zero; injectivity in lem-pur-degree-zero-derived-map-gluing gives the result, including the empty cover.

Fault (C4/E5) in Step 3. The hypothesis on c is over Zariski opens U_i that need not be affine. The step restricts Γ_{p_{d,i}} to Γ_{p_d,B} citing the last clause of lem-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-normalization, but that clause only covers affine V and U. No node states open base change of the all-n Γ.

Repair: Step 3 is rewritten.
- (b) U_i is Noetherian, of finite type and separated (two Mathlib leaves plus (e)). lem-pur-projection-purity-agreement on U_i together with the Step-1 unitor computation gives Γ_{p_{d,i}} = ϑ_{p_{d,i}}^{-1}. The chart theorem for p_{d,i} with u = id over affine B then gives Lw^*Γ_{p_{d,i}} = Γ_{p_d,B}.
- (c) The restriction of the ε identifications to T follows from the exceptional compositors and the associativity clause of thm-sf-comp-composition.
- proof_deps updated; three split_report.tool_uses added (two Mathlib leaves and comp-composition, already accepted as on-route for this unit).

Not duplicates: det-sp-orientation-vector-bundle and det-sp-orientation-charts are E = Q_ℓ only; lem-pur-composition-model-orientation-descent is the composition analogue. Edge cases checked: d = 0, empty or disconnected Z, n = 1, ramified E, and a unit rescaling of c.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
